Regarding the legal compliance of the provided paragraph: The actions described are compliant with legal standards. The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) requires public accommodations and commercial facilities to make reasonable modifications to policies, practices, and procedures to accommodate individuals with disabilities. Specifically, the ADA mandates that service animals be allowed to accompany their handlers in all areas where the public is allowed. While the ADA primarily covers service animals, the Fair Housing Act (FHA) and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act often extend similar protections to emotional support animals in housing contexts. By making exceptions for both service animals and emotional support animals, the landlord is adhering to federal disability rights laws that prohibit discrimination against individuals with disabilities.
